tools.name: execute_query
tools.description: Execute SQL query on a specific database connection

connection_name.description: Name of the database connection to execute query on

query.description: SQL query to execute (use parameterized queries for security)

database.description: Target database name (optional, defaults to connection default database)

parameters.description: Query parameters for parameterized queries (recommended for security)

tools.name: list_databases
tools.description: List databases from a specific connection or all configured connections

connection_name.description: Name of the connection to list databases from. If not provided, lists all configured connections.
Name of specific connection to retry. If not provided, retries all failed connections.

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List all database connections with detailed information and status

include_credentials.description: Include connection credentials (passwords will be masked)
